dataFlows.purpose: Troubleshoot crashes and non-fatal runtime failures
dataFlows.storage: application support directory/logs/app_error.log and bounded in-memory entries
dataFlows.consent: local operational diagnostics are not remotely uploaded; the existing ENABLE_DIAGNOSTICS build value is not yet wired to bootstrap logging and ENG-013 owns that future gate
dataFlows.retention: bounded to 300 in-memory entries; file persists locally until AppLogger.clear(), Settings > Privacy local reset, application data removal, or uninstall
dataFlows.deletion: Settings > Privacy > Delete & reset local data invokes local log clearing; AppLogger.clear(), clear application data, or uninstall are also effective

dataFlows.purpose: Refresh UMP privacy state, initialize Google Mobile Ads only when requests are permitted, and load banner, rewarded, and interstitial advertisements
dataFlows.storage: controlled by Google Mobile Ads SDK/platform
dataFlows.consent: Google UMP is refreshed on launch; Mobile Ads initialization and all app-owned ad request/load/show paths are fail-closed behind current canRequestAds state. The app does not persist a duplicate consent-granted value.
dataFlows.retention: third-party processor policy; must be reflected in PRIV-002/store disclosures
dataFlows.deletion: no first-party server copy exists; SDK/processor controls third-party retention and the first-party local reset does not claim to delete processor-side data
